QTextEdit.name: wizard_help
QTextEdit.text:
What the fields mean:
- Manufacturer ID: three letters used in the EDID product ID. - Product code and serial: identify the display to Windows. - Physical size: used for DPI and display information. - Native mode: the preferred resolution and refresh rate. - Timing formula: reduced blanking is a safe default for modern flat panels.
After you finish, the EDID is saved to the on-disk library (Library and live editor tab). You can export a file immediately, or install a reversible Windows override from the Windows Override tab or that library view.
